solution:
**Given:**

No of people who joined gym A in 2018 = 278

No of people who joined gym D in 2016 = 239

**Calculation:**

Difference between the people who joined gym A in 2018 and 2016 = 278 - 239 = 39

∴ The required percentage = 39/239 × 100 = 16.31%

**⇒ 16% (Approximately)**
